item.title: Deaths Likely Due to Cold Rise to 22 Including Those Found At Private Residences
item.description: The city’s Medical Examiner is investigating 22 deaths attributed to the recent cold snap, a number which includes 15 people found dead outdoors and another seven found at private residences who are also confirmed to have died of hypothermia. item.title: Nurses at NewYork-Presbyterian Reach Tentative Agreement to End Strike
item.description: The New York State Nurses Association and NewYork-Presbyterian reached a tentative agreement on raises, staffing and on-the-job safety to end its strike, the union announced late Tuesday night. item.description: New York City’s estimated $12 billion budget gap over the next two years shrank to $7 billion over the last few weeks after updating revenue and bonus estimates and tapping into reserves, Mayor Zohran Mamdani told state lawmakers Wednesday. item.title: NewYork-Presbyterian Nurses Reject Contract By Overwhelming Margin
item.description: NewYork-Presbyterian nurses rejected a tentative agreement by an overwhelming margin Wednesday, voting to extend their strike — now 31 days running — against the hospital system.
